tasks.prompt: An online shop: web app, API, database, job queue and an external payment gateway. About 10 nodes.
A monorepo with three nested groups (apps, services, data), about 20 nodes, and a `source` path on four of them.
Expense approval with a manager and a finance lane, one decision and a rejection path.
Employee onboarding with a retry loop when a check fails and a wait step for documents.
A blog: users, posts, comments, tags and post_tags; comments can reply to other comments (self-reference).
A payments schema with 8 tables, optional columns and several single-column foreign keys into the same table.
Login with OAuth: browser, app, identity provider; an `alt` for denied consent.
Checkout where the app retries a payment call in a `loop`, with a note over the payment provider.
